Emily Carter  
Full-Stack Developer | VitaHealth Solutions  
Email: emily.carter@email.com | Phone: (123) 456-7890 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/emilycarter  

Professional Summary  
Results-oriented Full-Stack Developer with 4 years of experience in healthtech, specializing in scalable web applications and cloud infrastructure. Proven ability to design and implement microservices, REST APIs, and data-driven solutions that enhance patient care and operational efficiency. Skilled in AWS, Kubernetes, and PostgreSQL, with a track record of optimizing performance and reducing latency through strategic architecture decisions.  

Work Experience  

VitaHealth Solutions | Full-Stack Developer (2022–Present)  
- Spearheaded the migration of core patient management systems to AWS, reducing infrastructure costs by 25% through optimized resource allocation and automated scaling.  
- Designed and deployed a PostgreSQL-based data pipeline that consolidated fragmented datasets, improving query latency by 25% and enabling real-time analytics for clinical decision support.  
- Led the integration of GraphQL APIs to replace legacy REST endpoints, enhancing data retrieval efficiency by 40% and reducing redundant data transfers across microservices.  
- Collaborated with DevOps teams to automate CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitLab, achieving 95% deployment success rate and reducing release cycles by 30%.  
- Developed and maintained React components for the provider portal, improving user engagement metrics by 18% through responsive design and performance optimizations.  

MedCare Solutions | Senior Full-Stack Developer (2021–2022)  
- Architectured a microservices-based platform for telehealth services, reducing system downtime by 40% through decoupled service communication and fault isolation.  
- Engineered a Python-based backend for patient scheduling, integrating with PostgreSQL to handle 10,000+ concurrent requests with sub-200ms response times.  
- Implemented Kubernetes orchestration for containerized applications, achieving 99.9% uptime and enabling seamless scaling during peak usage periods.  
- Redesigned REST APIs for medical records access, improving data consistency and reducing API call latency by 35% through caching and query optimization.  
- Mentored junior developers in best practices for Docker containerization, resulting in a 50% reduction in deployment errors and faster environment setup.  

HealthTrack Inc. | Junior Software Developer (2019–2021)  
- Developed Python scripts for data processing and reporting, streamlining manual workflows and reducing report generation time by 60%.  
- Contributed to the design of RESTful APIs for internal tools, ensuring seamless integration between front-end and back-end systems.  
- Collaborated on Docker containerization for application deployment, improving deployment consistency across development and production environments.  
- Assisted in setting up CI/CD pipelines for version control and automated testing, increasing deployment frequency and reducing manual intervention.  

Skills  
- Cloud Infrastructure: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda), Kubernetes orchestration, containerization with Docker  
- Application Development: React for dynamic user interfaces, Python for backend services, PostgreSQL for relational data management  
- API Architecture: RESTful API design for healthcare data integration, GraphQL implementation for efficient data fetching  
- DevOps Practices: CI/CD pipeline automation, infrastructure as code, microservices deployment strategies  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Michigan | 2020
